how_to_apply: Interested candidates may apply in the prescribed format given at Annexure-I.
Attach self-attested copies of educational and professional qualifications, proof of age, experience/service records and other relevant documents.
Furnish up-to-date copies of ACR/APARs for at least the last five years.
Attach two recent colour passport-size photographs, one pasted on the application form and the other enclosed.
Mention on the top of the envelope: Application for the post of Second Member, Vidyut Upbhokta Shikayat Nivaran Forum (VUSNF), - (Name of the Location).

Send by Speed Post to the office of General Manager (HR), Jharkhand Bijli Vitran Nigam Limited, Nigam Headquarters, Engineering Building, H.E.C., Dhurwa, Ranchi - 834004 on or before 06-11-2026 by 06:00 PM.
important_instructions: Applications received after the last date shall not be considered. The Nigam reserves the right to reject incomplete applications or applications received in a different format.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Degree in Electrical Engineering/ Electrical & Instrumentation/ Electrical & Electronics; CA; ICWA; MBA Finance Experience: At least 20 years of experience in transmission, distribution and trading of electricity or in accounts and finance in government department or commercial public undertaking. Age limit: Minimum 45 years and stipulated maximum age of 62 years (as on 1 August 2026) Other conditions: Appointed member shall not hold any other office of profit during tenure.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Retired members get last pay drawn minus pension; members without pension get honorarium equal to last pay drawn. DA and HRA as per State Government orders. Appointed initially for a period of 03 years, extendable up to further two years on satisfactory service or till 65 years of age, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of educational and professional qualifications Proof of age Experience/service records and other relevant documents Up-to-date copies of ACR/APARs for at least the last five years Two recent colour passport-size photographs Copy of pension order

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JBVNL Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Interested candidates may apply in the prescribed format given at Annexure-I. Attach self-attested copies of educational and professional qualifications, proof of age, experience/service records and other relevant documents. Furnish up-to-date copies of ACR/APARs for at least the last five years. Attach two recent colour passport-size photographs, one pasted on the application form and the other enclosed. Mention on the top of the envelope: Application for the post of Second Member, Vidyut Upbhokta Shikayat Nivaran Forum (VUSNF), - (Name of the Location). Send by Speed Post to the office of General Manager (HR), Jharkhand Bijli Vitran Nigam Limited, Nigam Headquarters, Engineering Building, H.E.C., Dhurwa, Ranchi - 834004 on or before 06-11-2026 by 06:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
